from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NonCurrentAssetItem(BaseModel):
    """One non-current asset item from a company's balance sheet."""
    asset_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the non-current asset category")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The reported amount for this asset")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency or scale unit (e.g., '元', '千元')")
    is_zero: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this asset has zero/no balance")

class NonCurrentAssetCompany(BaseModel):
    """Non-current assets for one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from this document")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    non_current_assets: list[NonCurrentAssetItem] = Field(description="List of non-current asset items for this company")
    total_non_current_assets: str | None = Field(description="Total non-current assets sum if reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies_non_current_assets: list[NonCurrentAssetCompany]
